SELECT VALUE {
    "id": c.id,
    "Name": c.Name,
    "Category": c.Category,
    "Visibility": c.Visibility,
    "Name": c.Name,
    "Category": c.Category,
    "Visibility": c.Visibility,
    "BillingType": c.BillingType,
    "MonthlyPriceUsd": c.MonthlyPriceUsd,
    "OneTimePriceUsd": c.OneTimePriceUsd
}
FROM c
ORDER BY c.Name ASC
